yr3t49kc.baseName: Christmas Tree World  40cm Red Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
yr3t49kc.variantName: Christmas Tree World  40cm Red Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
yr3t49kc.sourceDescription: Introducing the 40cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Red, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient. Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply. Product Features • Size: 40cm (other sizes available) • Colour: Red (other colours available) • Finish: High-gloss mirror effect • Material: Durable inflatable construction • Fire-resistant: Fire retardant material • Indoor & outdoor use • Installation options: Floor-standing, ceiling-hung, wall-mounted or secured to ground • Inflation: Inflated once and sealed no continuous air supply required • Storage: Fully deflates to take up minimal storage space • Pump: Electric air pump not included • Oversized gold bauble caps not included • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

pb5z14tv.sourceDescription: Create the ultimate festive Christmas display in your yard this holiday season with our 7.5ft tall Santa Claus with Gift Bag from HOMCOM. Designed with ultra-durable, weather-resistant, waterproof polyester and featuring an internal LED glow, this holiday display will create a festive focal point in your yard, invoking the holiday spirit for years to come. Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
